cards.back: Edits searchable within 15 minutes at p99; deletes, unpublishes and permission changes within 5 minutes. Alert at 12 and 4.

cards.front: Why not just run the batch job more often?
cards.back: It takes 6 hours and its cost grows with the corpus; even 10× hardware is 36 minutes and re-embeds 40M chunks for a few hundred changes.

cards.front: The change event is a pointer
cards.back: It carries source, doc_id, change (upsert, delete or acl_change) and version, but no content. The worker always fetches the latest.
All events for one doc land on one partition, so one consumer sees them in order.

cards.front: Finding deletes in a source that can't push
cards.back: "Modified since" never returns deleted pages. List all page IDs every 3 minutes and diff against the registry.
One row per doc: indexed version, chunk IDs, ACL, chunk hashes, stage timestamps and tombstones. The source of truth for what should be indexed.
If chunk IDs are doc#0…doc#19 and the new version has 17 chunks, 17–19 serve stale text forever. Version the IDs and delete by version.
Hash each chunk and reuse cached vectors for unchanged hashes; embed only changed chunks.
Update acl_groups and tenant_id on existing chunks: no re-chunking, no re-embedding, seconds.
The registry remembers deleted docs, so a late edit event can't bring one back.
Consumer lag, not CPU: lag tracks the freshness target. Max parallel workers equals the partition count.
The request trace: its chunk versions show at once whether to investigate the pipeline or the prompt.

quiz.q: Why does the change event carry no document content?
choices: Events stay tiny, and replays just fetch the current text
Content is sent in a second event
quiz.why: The worker always fetches the latest version.

quiz.q: A doc shrinks from 20 chunks to 17, and IDs are doc#0…doc#19. What goes wrong with plain upserts?
quiz.why: Versioned IDs plus delete-by-version avoid orphans.

quiz.q: How does the wiki poller detect deletes?
choices: Diffing all page IDs against the registry every 3 minutes
quiz.why: Modified-since never returns pages that no longer exist.

quiz.q: A release day brings 50,000 edits. How do deletes still meet 5 minutes?
choices: Deletes go first in the same topic
A separate priority topic with reserved workers
quiz.why: The priority lane keeps deletes from waiting behind edits.

quiz.q: What should the worker autoscale on?
A doc's permissions change. What work is needed?
choices: A metadata write to the existing chunks
quiz.why: ACL changes update acl_groups and tenant_id only.

quiz.q: How do you roll out a new embedding model?
choices: Switch the model and watch feedback
Embed only new docs with the new model
Build a new index, gate on the golden set, swap the alias
quiz.why: Blue-green with an atomic alias swap keeps rollback easy.
